a261001p1.summary: WeChat owner strikes deal to access US group's south-east Asia data centres amid race with ByteDance and Alibaba
a261001p1.title: Sources: Tencent signed a ~$7B, five-year deal with Oracle this year for access to ~100K advanced AI chips unavailable in China via Southeast Asian data centers (Zijing Wu/Financial Times)

a261001p10.summary: Asha Sharma didn't have any experience in video games when she became the chief executive of Xbox this year.
a261001p10.title: A profile of Xbox CEO Asha Sharma, who insists that "Xbox is not for sale" despite mass layoffs and divested studios since inheriting the flailing division (Zachary Small/New York Times)

a261001p11.summary: Huawei Technologies Co. plans to join rivals in jacking up smartphone prices to counter rising memory costs …
a261001p11.title: Huawei plans moderate smartphone price increases to counter an average $200 per-unit cost hike driven by rising memory component costs, and unveils new handsets (Bloomberg)

a261001p12.summary: Planned 400-megawatt data centre near Tokyo will be among Asia's largest projects outside China — Japan is aiming to speed …
a261001p12.title: Dell, Jera, and UK-based Rhaelm partner to build a $15B, 400MW off-grid AI data center and gas power plant near Tokyo, set to begin operations around 2028 (Financial Times)

a261001p13.summary: Jonathan Zepp, left, Google's head of entertainment content and platforms, and Peter Micelli, chief executive of Range Media Partners …
a261001p13.title: Google partners with talent agency Range Media to launch 100 Zeros, a rotating fund designed to shape positive onscreen depictions of tech and test AI tools (Brooks Barnes/New York Times)

a261001p14.summary: In an exclusive interview with WIRED, Paragon Solutions CEO Andrew Boyd reveals the limits of the company's promise …
a261001p14.title: An interview with Paragon Solutions CEO Andrew Boyd, who says the US spyware maker lacks visibility into customer targeting data and has no "kill switch" (Kim Zetter/Wired)

a261001p15.summary: Securities regulators looking at use of legal exemption by world's biggest crypto exchange — EU officials are questioning …
a261001p15.title: Sources: EU regulators are questioning Binance over its use of a legal exemption to continue serving customers in the region despite failing to secure a license (Financial Times)

a261001p16.summary: The Binance founder Changpeng Zhao, who pleaded guilty to violating an anti-money-laundering law, was pardoned by President Trump …
a261001p16.title: After a four-month US prison sentence, Changpeng Zhao is now living a gilded life in Abu Dhabi; he retains majority ownership of Binance and a $10B+ net worth (David Yaffe-Bellany/New York Times)

a261001p17.summary: Armadin said on Thursday that it raised $255.5 million in a Series B funding round, which values the AI cybersecurity company at more than $2.5 billion.
a261001p17.title: Armadin, started by Mandiant founder Kevin Mandia to build AI cybersecurity agents, raised a $255.5M Series B led by a16z and Accel at a $2.5B valuation (Anzar Mehraj/Reuters)

a261001p18.summary: Some of YMTC's patents can actually belong to Micron, the company alleges. … Micron this month filed a lawsuit …
a261001p18.title: Micron filed a US lawsuit accusing Chinese memory maker YMTC of systematically poaching key engineers and then using the engineers' patents to sue Micron (Anton Shilov/Tom's Hardware)

a261001p19.summary: After facing down regulators, oligopolies, and corruption in Latin America, Nubank founder David Vélez faces his biggest challenge yet: the United States
a261001p19.title: A profile of Nubank founder David Vélez, who graduated from Stanford, worked at Sequoia, and moved to Brazil to start the bank in 2013, as Nubank enters the US (Gabi Marques/Colossus)

a261001p2.summary: Posts huge leaps in revenue, profit, and margin, with more to come — Memory-maker Micron has warned that RAM shortages …
a261001p2.title: Micron CEO Sanjay Mehrotra says RAM shortages will persist into 2028 and perhaps beyond, and customers will pay "much higher prices" than they did this year (Simon Sharwood/The Register)

a261001p20.summary: A wave of little changes, including new colors, the option of an aluminum case, and some neat accessories.
a261001p20.title: Amazon updates the Kindle, Kindle Paperwhite, and Colorsoft with new colors and up to 32GB of storage, and unveils the $35 Kindle Click page-turning remote (Cameron Faulkner/The Verge)

a261001p21.summary: Anthropic's IPO prospectus documents extensive partnerships with a handful of big tech firms. One stands out: chip maker Broadcom (AVGO.O).
a261001p21.title: IPO prospectus: Broadcom agreed to lend Anthropic up to $42B via convertible notes that could help finance Anthropic's $125.2B, five-year TPU lease commitment (Reuters)

a261001p3.summary: New findings by Asymmetric Security provide further evidence of novel tactics AI tools use to conduct hacks.
a261001p3.title: Asymmetric Security investigation: OpenAI agents pulled data from 55 business, nonprofit, and government agency websites while actively obscuring their actions (Rafe Rosner-Uddin/Financial Times)

a261001p4.summary: Ted Sarandos, co-chief executive officer at Netflix Inc., said the US streaming giant isn't growing as quickly as he would like.
a261001p4.title: Netflix co-CEO Ted Sarandos says growth is slower than he'd like and defends the WBD pursuit, adding Netflix isn't seeking another acquisition to replace it (Sohee Kim/Bloomberg)

a261001p5.summary: The customer research space is especially ripe for AI disruption, as companies look to replace older, manual methods to more quickly find out what customers think.
a261001p5.title: Salesforce agrees to buy AI customer research startup Listen Labs, reportedly for $2B; Listen Labs had raised a $69M Series B at a $500M valuation in January (Chris Metinko/Axios)

a261001p6.summary: US corporations including Google, Apple and Amazon use their influence to push back against EU digital bloc rules.
a261001p6.title: Analysis: Google, Apple, and Amazon each have more meetings with European parliament and European Commission officials than any individual European company (Financial Times)

a261001p7.summary: Claude Code CLI and Claude for Microsoft 365 also now available in early access. — Product announcements — Product
a261001p7.title: Anthropic says Claude for Government is now generally available to federal and state agencies, with Claude Code CLI and Claude for Microsoft 365 in early access (Claude)

a261001p8.summary: Nikesh Arora is the guy CEOs of Fortune 500 and tech companies call when AI gets scary. — In April, Nikesh Arora applied a simple …
a261001p8.title: A profile of Palo Alto Networks CEO Nikesh Arora, who has overseen revenue growth from $2.27B in FY 2018 to $11.48B in FY 2026, as AI reshapes cybersecurity (Allie Garfinkle/Fortune)

a261001p9.summary: Powerful AI tools burn through budgets, prompting a rethink of how the technology is priced ahead of frontier lab IPOs.
a261001p9.title: SemiAnalysis estimates ~90% of Anthropic's business comes from agentic AI, while sources say nearly 25% of its revenue in 2025 came from just two clients (Financial Times)
